resumen: The same horizontal push as the bench press, but moving the body instead of the load, with the trunk working to keep from sagging.
ejecucion: Put your hands on the floor slightly wider than your shoulders, body in a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze glutes and abs so the hips neither sag nor pike up.
Lower by bending the elbows about 45 degrees from the body, until the chest is close to the floor.
Push the floor away until the arms are straight, keeping the body line.
